spots.name: Picture Rock Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.

spots.name: Christmas Valley
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 189 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L3059897.

spots.name: Aspen Butte
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,668 m (5,471 ft).

spots.name: Pattern Butte
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,737 m (5,698 ft).

spots.name: Braken Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.

spots.name: Green Mountain Lookout
spots.tip: A lookout tower or fire lookout: a full-circle view, so it works at sunrise and sunset. Many are staffed in summer and some can be rented.

spots.name: Derrick Cave
spots.tip: A cave entrance. Bring a headlamp and a tripod; light from the opening makes the picture. Check whether it's closed for bats or ice.
